scoring_justification: The agent's computed frequencies are compared directly to the paper-reported values (7.5e3 Hz and 8.8e2 Hz) with a 10% relative tolerance. Recomputing in the checker is possible but the paper values serve as the hidden gold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference frequencies for the two tunneling processes
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper sections: '7.5\u00d710^3 Hz' for polarization and '8.8\u00d710^2 Hz' for domain wall.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper's numeric claims.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the paper for the same conditions as the task.

schema.description: The file contains one line with a single positive float number representing the tunnel splitting frequency in Hz.

outputs.description: Scored result for polarization tunneling frequency. The checker will compare the numeric value to the paper-reported reference within a hidden tolerance.

schema.description: The file contains one line with a single positive float number representing the domain wall tunneling frequency in Hz.

outputs.description: Scored result for domain wall tunneling frequency. The checker will compare the numeric value to the paper-reported reference within a hidden tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The two output files contain the two headline frequencies reported in the paper. The agent must implement the cluster approximation for the attempt frequency and perform unit conversions from cgs to SI. No external data files are needed; all required parameters are provided in the instruction.

steps.description: Polarization tunneling frequency must be within 10% of 7500 Hz.
Domain wall tunneling frequency must be within 10% of 880 Hz.
